title: God and His People Face to Face
questions: If your spiritual life were a road trip, what would the GPS currently say? (“recalculating,” “continue straight ahead” “taking the scenic route,” “searching for a signal,” etc.).

How does Moses’ relationship with God develop throughout Exodus? Which part of Moses’ journey stands out to you most right now in your current season of life: doubting, leading, interceding, or encountering God?
Read Exodus 33:12. Why is it significant that Moses relies on God's favor rather than his own performance?
Read Exodus 33:13-17. How does Moses define ‘the people of God’ according to these verses? What does this reveal about how much God delights in even one person who wants to know Him?
What does it mean that God knows Moses by name? What is the difference between simply knowing about God and truly knowing God relationally?
Read Exodus 33:18-23. How does it make you feel to realize that God is so powerful He could overwhelm us, yet so gentle that He makes a way for us to be near Him?

Read Exodus 34:5-7. How does God define Himself in these verses? Why is it so striking that God defines Himself relationally rather than theologically? Which of these qualities is easiest for you to believe right now? Which one feels the hardest to trust?

Read Exodus 3:11. Read Exodus 4:1. Read Exodus 4:13. Moses demonstrated all kinds of doubt on the journey. How comfortable are you bringing doubts, frustrations, or disagreements to God? How does seeing yourself as a son or daughter of God change the way you approach Him in prayer?
Read 2 Corinthians 3:7-18. Without getting lost in the technical details, how does Paul describe our access to God today compared to the "veiled" experience Moses had?
Where are you at in your relationship with God? If you were to dream really BIG, what would relationship with God look like in 5, 10, 15 years down the road?

sections.title: Pray
sections.body: Pray that we may grow in understanding how deeply loved we are by an all-powerful God. Pray that we may grow in dreaming about what our relationship with God may look like as we look to the future. As we continue to reflect on this message, pray that we would be transformed more into the image of Jesus.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.body: Check out the resources page for links to several Bible reading plans and other helpful tools. Explore other opportunities for growth and transformation by checking out courses.
